text: {"assertions":["A malformed record issue in ingest/pipeline/parser.py was resolved on 2026-01-29.","Connection pool exhaustion under burst load was the root cause of the malformed record issue.","The malformed record issue manifested only on the staging read replica.","The malformed record appeared as a decode error pointing at a specific byte offset.","The fix involved raising the connection pool ceiling and adding a bounded wait queue in PR #6069 on branch fix/malformed-record-1.","The mixed-encoding sample file reproduces the malformed record issue.","After the fix, throughput improved by 87 percent to reach 684 requests per second."]}
